title: unit-used-by-no-unit rule; unit-not-in-dpr outside the project roots
summary: Warns (ON) on a unit only the .dpr lists that nothing reaches; a form counts only when opened. unit-not-in-dpr also reports shared-folder units (the whole compile closure minus library / third-party roots)
intro: Read this to see when unit-used-by-no-unit warns, which self-registering units it leaves alone, why a form with an initialization section still fires, and how lint-all --project now reports shared-folder units missing from the project files.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint-all --db <file.sqlite> [--project <file.dproj>] [--rule unit-used-by-no-unit|unit-not-in-dpr] (unit-used-by-no-unit: default ON, category project-wide, warning, lint-all only; exempt: initialization section or container registration, a form only when the program code or a FindClass('TName') string opens it; unit-not-in-dpr: the whole compile closure minus the library / third-party roots (registry library paths + manifest Library include), units outside the project roots reported on the .dpr)
